question.text: Under the SEBI-specified Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) mechanism for PMS, the ODR platform is facilitated by:

answer.text: Market Infrastructure Institutions (MIIs), which auto-assign requests to an MII ODR platform
The Finance Ministry as an alternative to civil court

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook explains that ODR is mandatory for PMS providers under the SEBI-specified mechanism, and that the Market Infrastructure Institutions (MIIs) facilitate the process by auto-assigning dispute requests to an MII ODR platform. The Trap: The platform is not described in the workbook as being directly administered by SEBI as an alternative to civil court. The workbook also notes that, after an arbitration award, an unsatisfied party may still approach the courts, so ODR is not an absolute substitute for civil litigation. Note: Disclose the SEBI-specified ODR route in client documentation so that investors know how disputes will be routed through the MII ODR platform before any escalation to courts.
